normal.name: Ravanon
normal.text: Another October art challenge complete. A month of drawings of characters from anime, comics and videogames, using the #Arttrober2026 list published by Stanley Lau. It was fun, but also exhausting—and it killed almost all my free time for a month. But there was still one thing to do: compile all 31 drawings into a single image—so that's what I've gone and done. Any favourites? #Arttrober #Drawtober #Inktober #MastoArt #FediArt #FanArt #Manga #Anime #Comics #Gaming #Cartoon
